name: St. Croix County, WI
findings: St. Croix County has 220 nonprofit organizations. 118 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 95 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Croix County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
